ar_body: تقدّم Replit برنامج شركاء الحلول لمساعدة المؤسسات على توظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي في بناء البرمجيات داخل مختلف الفرق.
body:
When anyone in an organization can put AI to work on the problems they know best, the way the organization operates starts to change. Designers turn ideas into working software that engineers can review and build on. HR builds its own onboarding tools. Finance replaces messy spreadsheets with live, custom dashboards. Support teams use agents to investigate issues and resolve tickets faster. The opportunity goes beyond building more software: it’s helping teams save time, reduce costs, and serve customers better.

So the question isn’t just what you can build. It’s where AI can create the most value for your business, and how to turn that potential into measurable results.

Replit's team works with our customers every day to answer those questions. And for the past few years, a growing community of systems integrators, consultancies, and agencies has been answering them too, independently. Many have built entire businesses around this work, hired teams, and become experts in AI enablement and a new way of building software. Others are some of the most established names in their fields, with decades of experience serving enterprises across industries and continents, and they are now choosing Replit to lead their clients into what comes next.

Today we're introducing the Replit Solutions Partner Program to bring Replit into more organizations, and deeper into every team within them, from first-time founders building their first company to major Fortune 500 companies. The program gives the solutions partners already doing this work more support to grow, and gives prospective partners a clear path to get certified on Replit's enterprise features.

If you're a systems integrator, consultancy, or agency ready to help organizations reorganize around code, we want you here. Together, we can help every business become self-driving .

## What is the Replit Solutions Partner Program?

For our customers, the Replit Solutions Partner Program connects them to the right systems integrators, consultants, and agencies that can help them identify opportunities, develop solutions, and get their teams building efficiently on Replit. Depending on the needs and the partner they work with, that could mean getting an initial application off the ground, running hands-on workshops, or planning how to introduce Replit across an organization.

For solutions partners, the program is a way to bring their industry knowledge, customer relationships, and implementation experience to Replit’s AI-powered software development. Through training, enablement, and collaboration on customer opportunities, we’ll help solutions partners stay current with Replit and the evolving ways businesses use AI to solve practical problems.

## Hear from some of our solutions partners

“Every enterprise wants to move faster—from idea to working application, and from prototype to production. Our collaboration with Replit puts that capability in the hands of more teams, breaking down the barriers between business vision and technical execution.”

~ Ram Ramalingam Global lead for Software and Platform Engineering, Accenture

“Replit has the potential to dramatically transform enterprise software development by expanding creativity while maintaining strong governance and optimizing costs. Through shared values, continuous dialogue, collaboration between our CEOs, and hands-on training for colleagues at Replit, we have developed ‘Enterprise Vibe Coding’: a secure and collaborative approach that combines Replit and assetforce to turn real business needs into working systems. We have already built a production-ready enterprise application in just a week using Replit and are now applying the same approach to mission-critical systems, including fixed-asset accounting software.”

~ Takeshi Fujiwara Corporate Officer, Digital Lab, Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Company, Limited (SMFL)

“Customers value Replit for enabling faster, higher-quality application development. In one case, a customer built a new business prototype in just one month and used it to validate market needs with end users.”

~ Koji Mio General Manager, Business Design & Marketing Department, Enterprise & Social Business Sector, JSOL CORPORATION

“Helping bring Replit to [enterprise clients] is a privilege for Snowman Labs. The [Replit] team believes that people who understand a problem should have the chance to build the solution. As an early Solutions Partner, Snowman Labs brings Replit to clients in Brazil and works alongside their teams to make that possible. This is what makes Replit’s mission so meaningful to the company: helping more people create, solve real problems, and put their ideas to work.”

~ Danilo Brizola Founder, Snowman Labs

## Why we’re excited

At Replit, we believe more people should be able to transform, rethink, and empower their organization with code. Solutions Partners help us bring that possibility to more businesses.

They bring something essential: an understanding of their customers. Solutions Partners bring deep expertise in their own markets, languages, and industries, from financial services in Tokyo to manufacturing in São Paulo.

## Create with us

We’re bringing together partners who share our belief that more people should be able to turn their ideas into outcomes, and feel excited about assisting teams to become a self-driving company.

Visit the Replit Solutions Partner page to learn more and apply to become a partner: https://replit.com/partners/solutions-partners
